reason: The first Task30 run was technically valid but its 8ms primary horizon had zero injected-current exposure because stimulus onset was >=8ms. Confirm the same scientific claim on disjoint, actively stimulated conditions before any Task31 decision.
decision: Preflight demands injected-current exposure in all 24 non-rest episodes before 8ms. After that, the unchanged Task30 primary threshold applies to every frozen both-arm family/seed: pooled 8ms voltage RMSE <=1mV, worst episode <=2mV, finite traces and no state occupancy or physical-voltage violations. Longer horizons and none-arm are diagnostic. Zero active reference threshold crossings must be reported and limits interpretation, not silently treated as a full active-neuron confirmation.
limits: Single-compartment fixed semi-implicit formula-map reference, not independently validated full active NEURON. Calcium and injection imposed. No CaDynamics, axial/synaptic coupling, morphology, deployment speed or Task31 authorization. Gate D performance remains NO-GO. The confirmation changes fresh initial voltage, calcium and stimulus timing/amplitude; frozen checkpoints and numerical thresholds remain unchanged.
